# Vec1 source

`vec1.c` comes from SQLite 3.54.0, `ext/vec1/vec1.c`, in the official
[`sqlite-src-3540000.zip`](https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-src-3540000.zip)
archive. The source archive SHA-256 is
`8847659821e0c5116bd14a94644c82ba932b2d9a05ac81af2e34af814aad7c58`;
the copied `vec1.c` SHA-256 is
`4f9a83efd78992769ba7a8e630d755b93370258387694498f22d1eb3cfd3e766`.

The source begins with SQLite's public-domain dedication. It is compiled into
`vec1.so` during the Semantic SQLite build. No local changes were made to `vec1.c`.
